description: Configure the bot status, activity type and interval settings here

content.name: enableStatusCommand
content.description: If enabled, administrators can change the bot status using the /status slash command

content.name: enableInterval
content.description: If enabled the bot will change its status every x seconds

content.name: intervalStatuses
content.description: Statuses from which the bot should randomly choose one

params.name: onlineMemberCount
params.description: Count of online members on your guild (will not work if presence intent not enabled)

params.name: memberCount
params.description: Count of members on your guild

params.name: randomMemberTag
params.description: Tag of one random member on your guild

params.name: randomOnlineMemberTag
params.description: Tag of one random member who is online on your guild

params.name: channelCount
params.description: Count of channels on your guild

params.name: roleCount
params.description: Count of roles on your guild

content.name: interval
content.description: The interval in seconds (at least 10 seconds)

content.name: changeOnUserJoin
content.description: If the status should be changed if someone joins your guild

content.name: userJoinStatus
content.description: Status that will be set if a user joins

params.name: memberCount
params.description: New member count of your guild

content.name: streamingLink
content.description: Will be shown, if the activity-typ is streaming and your link is supported by Discord
